Alt text: 

The smartphone UI displays account information and options for a user signed in as appcrawler4@gmail.com. The "Account Information" section includes:

- Email: appcrawler4@gmail.com
- First Name: John
- Last Name: Smith
- Password: ********
- Zip Code: 94101
- Country: UNITED STATES

Below the account information, there are two buttons: "EDIT INFO" and "SIGN OUT."

The "App Content" section provides a prompt to click to ensure the latest messages, devotions, events, and more are updated. There is a button labeled "UPDATE CONTENT."

In the bottom right corner, the version number "v3.1" is displayed.
A blue button with the text "UPDATE CONTENT" followed by a right-pointing arrow.
"Back button icon, represented by a left-pointing triangle."
The image shows a text message indicating the current signed-in email address. The text reads: "You are currently signed in as appcrawler4@gmail.com".
Alt text: "Sign Out button with a right arrow icon."
Text on a smartphone UI element: "Click to be sure you have the latest messages, devotions, events and more."
Smartphone status bar displaying various icons from left to right: Facebook notification, signal strength, Wi-Fi signal, Bluetooth enabled, battery level, and current time "5:59".
Button labeled "EDIT INFO" with a right arrow icon.

compos.summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is a "Settings" page for an application. The main contents and functions of this screen include:

1. **User Information**: Displays the email address of the currently signed-in user.
2. **Account Information**: Shows detailed account information including:
   - Email
   - First Name
   - Last Name
   - Password (obscured for security)
   - Zip Code
   - Country

3. **Edit Info Button**: Allows the user to edit their account information.
4. **Sign Out Button**: Provides an option for the user to sign out of their account.
5. **App Content Section**: Informs the user to update the app content to ensure they have the latest messages, devotions, events, and more.
6. **Update Content Button**: Allows the user to update the app content.

The screen also shows the app version number (v3.1) at the bottom right corner.
